steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Who decides what" [level=1]
  - note:
    - paragraph: "Preview Checked when an automation is made. Not enforced while it runs: that needs named approvers, which are planned."
  - status: Version 1 saved by you (not signed).
  - paragraph: "Good to know: Only you have saved these rules. A second person can confirm them once the Team plan exists. Nothing else is needed today."
  - heading "People and roles" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: "You: Admin, Builder, Approver, Rule owner, Auditor"
    - listitem: "Dana: Approver, Rule owner"
  - heading "Who approves what" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: "Money going out: above €250 needs Dana's yes"
    - listitem: "A message leaving the company: always needs your yes"
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Planned Planned: a reminder after a day. Today nothing reminds anyone."
    - 'link "What you can do today: check Waiting for you"':
      - /url: "#/waiting"
  - heading "Rules Foundry checks when you make an automation" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: Money out above €250 needs Dana's yes; whoever asked for it can't approve it. Org policy Written down by you for Dana. Dana has not confirmed it.
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Planned Planned: whoever asked for it can't approve it. Not checked yet."
    - 'link "What you can do today: each run''s page shows who started it and who approved its list"':
      - /url: "#/runs"
  - button "Change it"
  - link "Try it on a card":
    - /url: "#/make/expense-approval"
  - group: ▸ Show details

- main:
  - list "Steps":
    - listitem: "Step 1 of 4: Choose"
    - listitem: "Step 2 of 4: Test"
    - listitem: "Step 3 of 4: Turn on"
    - listitem: "Step 4 of 4: Use your own list"
  - heading "Approve small expenses" [level=1]
  - region "I'll do this:":
    - heading "I'll do this:" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Read the claims still waiting for a decision
      - listitem: Approve on its own each claim up to 250 that has a receipt
      - listitem: Note every decision in a decisions list on this computer
      - listitem: Draft an e-mail to the address you give listing the claims they need to decide. You see it first, and you send it
      - listitem: Check that nothing over the limit was approved, and re-read the drafts and the decisions list
    - heading "It won't:" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Pay or reimburse anyone
      - listitem: Approve anything over 250
      - listitem: Change your list of claims
      - listitem: "See the approver's reply: you record their answer in Foundry"
      - listitem: "Run by itself: you start each run"
  - heading "A few questions" [level=2]
  - text: Up to what amount should it approve on its own?
  - paragraph: €250 · set by you for Dana (Org policy). Dana hasn't confirmed it
  - spinbutton "Up to what amount should it approve on its own?": "250"
  - paragraph: "Why I'm asking: A wrong limit would approve spending you would refuse. I will not guess it. If you skip: Nothing is built until you choose a limit."
  - paragraph: Written down in Who decides what. You can make it stricter here, not looser.
  - text: Who decides claims over your limit? (their e-mail)
  - textbox "Who decides claims over your limit? (their e-mail)":
    - /placeholder: name@yourbusiness.com
  - paragraph: "Why I'm asking: Expense details go to this person; I will not guess who it is. If you skip: Nothing is built: the bigger claims have to go to someone."
  - group "How is their decision recorded?":
    - text: How is their decision recorded?
    - radio "The person you named gets an e-mail. They reply, and you record their answer here. Free" [checked]
    - text: The person you named gets an e-mail. They reply, and you record their answer here. Free
    - radio "The person you named signs in and decides, and their yes is recorded as theirs"
    - text: The person you named signs in and decides, and their yes is recorded as theirs
    - button "Team plan"
  - region "Settings already chosen for you":
    - heading "Settings already chosen for you" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Change any of them now, or later.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Needs a receipt to be approved on its own: Yes"
        - button "Change"
      - listitem:
        - text: "Tell people when their claim is approved: No"
        - button "Change"
  - term: "Uses AI:"
  - definition: No, it follows fixed steps.
  - term: "Where your data goes:"
  - definition: It stays on this computer. Only the e-mails you choose to send leave it, from your own mail app.
  - term: "When it runs:"
  - definition: Only when you start it, with Show me what it would make. There is no schedule yet.
  - status
  - button "Test it with pretend claims"
  - link "Back to all automations":
    - /url: "#/"
  - paragraph: The test uses pretend data and a pretend inbox. Nothing real is made or sent.
